n: Hikvision 16 Port Gigabit Smart POE Switch

specs.label: Ports
specs.value: 16 × Gigabit PoE port,1 × Gigabit RJ45 port,1 × Gigabit fiber optical port

specs.label: Long Range
specs.value: Ports 1 to 16: up to 300 m. Long range performance may vary depend on camera model or cable condition.

specs.label: Port Isolation
specs.value: Ports 1 to 18: port isolation mode to improve network security Ports in an isolation group cannot communicate with each other, but they can communicate with ports outside the isolation group.

specs.label: PoE Watchdog
specs.value: Ports 1 to 16: auto detect and restart the cameras that do not respond.

specs.label: Link Aggregation
specs.value: Link aggregation is used to aggregate multiple physical ports to form a logical port for load balancing, bandwidth expansion, and port protection. Support static link aggregation. Support 8 aggregation groups.
